purpose: GC-BREAK regime/volatility-break early-warning context; not direction forecasting

parent_findings.candidate_b_hourly: finer timing but too nonselective when every MAP contraction is treated as a signal

authority_rationale.adams_mackay_2007: use posterior run-length filtering; their finance example models daily returns with zero mean and piecewise-constant variance
authority_rationale.wilson_nassar_gold_2010: treating changepoint hazard as fixed and known is a practical limitation; hazard uncertainty should be learned rather than selected from one challenge-like year
authority_rationale.andersen_bollerslev_intraday: high-frequency financial volatility has strong intraday periodicity and should be adjusted before modelling
authority_rationale.altamirano_briol_knoblauch_2023: standard BOCPD can create spurious changepoints under model misspecification/outliers; do not equate every MAP run-length drop with an alert

chronology.note: 2025 was already viewed in earlier Candidate A/B research, so V3 cannot claim pristine independent challenge evidence

clock.session_gate: Sunday 18-23; Monday-Thursday 00-16 and 18-23; Friday 00-16 America/New_York; Saturday none
clock.daily_event_close: 16:00 America/New_York research bar start, available after bar completion

observation_model.beta0: 2022 pooled standardized-return sample variance times alpha0_minus_1
observation_model.reason: align detector with volatility-regime changes rather than directional mean changes

hazard.note: discrete hazard model averaging is an auditable approximation to hazard uncertainty; it is not claimed to reproduce the full Wilson-Nassar-Gold hierarchy

change_score.definition: posterior mass that current run length is at most K eligible hourly observations after hazard-model averaging
change_score.episode_rule: onset after P consecutive scores >= threshold; episode clears after P consecutive scores < threshold

development_event_target.sigma20: sample standard deviation of immediately preceding 20 governed daily returns, current excluded

alarm_rule_selection_2023.clean_hit_requirement: alert onset strictly before the previous governed daily close availability of the event and no more than H calendar hours before event close availability
alarm_rule_selection_2023.episode_precision: alert onsets whose next event satisfies clean_hit_requirement divided by all alert onsets
alarm_rule_selection_2023.event_recall: events with at least one qualifying onset divided by all events

replay_2025.state_continuity: continuous online state from 2023 through 2024 into 2025; no calendar-year reset
replay_2025.same_event_or_intraday_move_warning: not counted as clean early warning under strict metric

governance.future_robust_DSM_successor: allowed only as separately named identity if V3 remains too sensitive
